effects.description: Blocks Buffs from being applied to the recipient.Jinx Buffs will not block Control Buffs, and each Jinx buff will only negate a single Buff before expiring. This debuff can be stacked.

bio: Kosmi's cornered the market on voidsmithing, a very experimental smithing style that only uses gems found in the reality-bending Voidscar. Getting such gems requires her venturing into this mad realm, fighting off humongous Demons and crossing Shreds where the skies rain molten metal. She's even come to the aid of Durlag and his Voidstormers on her travels – so much so she's an honorary member.
